summary: Master inventory control for manufacturing operations with ABC analysis, EOQ, cycle counting, and practical ERP-based workflows.
lede: Inventory control for manufacturing operations helps professionals plan, track, and correct stock levels so production materials, work in progress, and finished goods remain available where needed. This course develops practical capability in ABC analysis, EOQ, cycle counting, ERP records, WMS workflows, and control checks aligned with ISO 9001 process discipline. You will practice variance analysis, reorder point calculations, safety stock setting, slotting, shortage escalation, automated reorder alerts, and inventory scorecard design. The training also covers reporting, replenishment rules, AI-assisted demand signals, and ERP workflow automation to support reliable records, visible reconciliation issues, and practical corrective action.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with inventory records, warehouse movements, production supply, and inventory reporting in manufacturing environments. Inventory controllers managing stock accuracy and transaction control. Materials coordinators tracking raw material availability for production. Production planners balancing demand, lead times, and material release. Warehouse supervisors controlling receiving, issuing, and storage discipline. Supply chain analysts reviewing inventory turns and replenishment data. Procurement officers coordinating supplier lead times and shortages. Manufacturing operations managers overseeing plant inventory performance. ERP super users maintaining inventory master data and transactions. Internal auditors checking stock records and control compliance. MRO planners handling spare parts and maintenance inventory.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, a spreadsheet tool such as Microsoft Excel, and if possible sample inventory records, cycle count sheets, or ERP reports from your own work setting. Familiarity with manufacturing stock movements, lead times, and basic numerical analysis will help you complete the exercises efficiently.
